versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support recording timing events of runnable entities. Description: AUTOSAR shall support recording and tracing of runnable entities state changes. Rationale: Provide standardized way to trace timing events on runnable entities state changes to ensure tool compatibility and compatibility with TIMEX. Dependencies: – Use Case: Add a trace instrumentation to runnable entities state changes. Supporting Material: -
